name: status-glyph
title: Status Glyph
description: One glyph per state in agent UI: ✓ done in the blue accent, ◌ not started, ◐ running (still), ⊘ skipped, ✗ failed, ⚠ needs you — never green, never a fill.

meta.whenToUse: The state of a chat step, task, Subagent, request or upload, in a row or a meta line.
meta.whenNotToUse: Workflow status of a record (StatusIcon), a live loop (TextSpinner), or a pass/fail result outside agent UI (Badge).
